title: The Tommy Dorsey and Benny Goodman near fight
summary: Waiting hours for a late Goodman, Tommy Dorsey lost his temper and threw his trombone at Barnet, and the two leaders swung at each other without their glasses.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Well, we had been in there, we're waiting. We had been up all night, and we're in there and they were doing some connecting things, you know, and we're sitting there, and we're waiting for Benny, and we were called at 8:00 o'clock in the morning, and that's makeup at 7:30, and we're waiting and we're waiting and we're waiting, and no Goodman. And finally they call his house. "Well, Mr. Goodman is having breakfast." Well, then, "Mr. Goodman will be there pretty soon." Well, to make a long story short, Benny

comes walking in around 11:30. By now, Tommy's fuse is lit. He's so mad he cannot be contained, you know, and one word led to another and we started in, you know. And we played it, it was a thing in unison, and we finished the thing. Little rings, we were doing. And Benny just kept on playing, like that, so Tommy said, "All right, Benny. We all know how good you play. Now come on, let's do this and get out of here. We've been here all morning." And one word led to another. Tommy threw his trombone at me and I caught it, and he took his glasses off and he started for Benny. Benny took his glasses off, and now they've got both their glasses off and neither one of them can see, and all they did was knock over a bunch of music stands. Nobody landed a punch. And of course there was the inevitable guy on the set that called up the Herald Examiner and said, "Tommy Dorsey and Benny Goodman just had a fight on the set of the --," oh, it was ridiculous.
